audio_v3.complaint: user heard stitched-together music and overlapping effects in the studio
causes: 12 sound effects in 13 s on top of the music hits
section edges off the bar grid (2.5, 12.4, 13 s at 120 BPM) switching layers mid-bar
a drum fill at every section edge, 7 dB section level span, one-beat ramps
